requirements.title: MAXLOC argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an integer, real, or character array; DIM shall be an integer scalar in the range 1 through the rank of ARRAY; optional MASK shall be logical and conformable with ARRAY; optional KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression; optional BACK shall be a logical scalar.

pending.MAXLOC-ARRAY-integer-real-or-character-a: Positive source controls call MAXLOC with integer, exact real, and character arrays; source-control mutations use scalar, logical-array, and complex-array ARRAY actuals and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MAXLOC-DIM-integer-scalar-in-range: Positive source controls use DIM=1 and DIM=2 for a rank-two array; source-control mutations use DIM=0, DIM=3, and a noninteger DIM and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MAXLOC-MASK-logical-conformable: Positive source controls use absent MASK, scalar-free conformable logical MASK arrays, and mixed true/false masks; source-control mutations use nonlogical or nonconformable MASK values and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MAXLOC-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expr: Positive source control calls MAXLOC with KIND=KIND(0); source-control mutations use noninteger and nonconstant KIND expressions and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MAXLOC-BACK-logical-scalar: Positive source controls use absent BACK, BACK=.false., and BACK=.true.; source-control mutations use nonlogical and nonscalar BACK values and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MAXLOC result type, kind, rank, and shape
requirements.definition: MAXLOC returns integer results; KIND presence controls result kind, KIND absence gives default integer, absent DIM gives a rank-one result of size rank(ARRAY), and present DIM gives rank n-1 with the DIM extent removed.

pending.MAXLOC-result-integer-type: Assign MAXLOC of an integer array to integer variables initialized to nonzero sentinels and assert exact location values; mutate the intrinsic to MAXVAL in source review so assignment rank/type checks fail outside this diagnostic-free facet.
pending.MAXLOC-result-kind-from-KIND: Probe for a nondefault integer kind via SELECTED_INT_KIND; upon a positive kind value, evaluate MAXLOC(A,KIND=that_kind), assert KIND of each result element equals that kind, and mutate KIND to KIND(0) so the kind check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-result-default-kind-absent: Evaluate MAXLOC(A) without KIND and assert KIND of result elements equals KIND(0); companion MAXLOC(A,KIND=KIND(0)) guards against an absent-call parser special case.
pending.MAXLOC-no-DIM-rank-one-size-rank: Use a rank-three integer array with a unique maximum, assert RANK(MAXLOC(A))==1 and SIZE(MAXLOC(A))==3, and mutate the array rank to two so the size check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-DIM-rank-and-shape: Use a [2,3,4] integer array and DIM=2, assert SHAPE(MAXLOC(A,DIM=2))==[2,4], and mutate DIM to 1 so the shape check fails.

requirements.title: MAXLOC without DIM returns maximum-element subscripts or zero defaults
requirements.definition: Without DIM, MAXLOC returns subscripts in one-based extent coordinates for an unmasked or masked maximum element; zero-size ARRAY or all-false MASK gives all zero result elements.

pending.MAXLOC-no-DIM-unmasked-location: Use an integer array declared with lower bounds -2:-1 and 5:6 and a unique maximum at declared subscripts (-1,5); assert MAXLOC returns [2,1] in extent coordinates and mutate the expected lower-bound coordinates so the check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-no-DIM-masked-location: Use a nonempty integer array with an unmasked larger value and a masked smaller selected maximum; assert MAXLOC(A,MASK) returns the true-mask location and mutate MASK to all true so the check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-no-DIM-subscript-range-independen: Use shifted lower bounds with extents [2,2], assert every returned subscript lies between 1 and the corresponding extent and equals the extent-coordinate location, and mutate the declaration lower bounds to produce a lower-bound-based expected value so the check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-zero-size-result-zero: Use a zero-size integer array with rank two and a nonvacuous nonempty companion; assert MAXLOC(zero_size)==[0,0] and companion MAXLOC(nonempty) is nonzero, then mutate the zero-size extent to one so the zero result check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-all-false-mask-result-zero: Use a nonempty integer array with MASK all false and a companion mask with one true element; assert the all-false result is all zero and the companion is nonzero, then mutate one false mask element to true so the zero check fails.

requirements.title: MAXLOC with DIM maps rank-one and higher-rank slices
requirements.definition: With DIM, rank-one ARRAY gives the first element of the corresponding no-DIM MAXLOC result, and higher-rank ARRAY applies MAXLOC along each DIM slice with MASK, KIND, and BACK forwarded.

pending.MAXLOC-DIM-rank-one-first-element: Use rank-one integer array [5,-9,3] and assert MAXLOC(A,DIM=1)==1 plus MAXLOC(A)==[1]; mutate DIM result expectation to the no-DIM rank-one array shape so the scalar check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-DIM-higher-rank-slice-results: Use a 2x3 integer array with distinct column and row maxima, assert MAXLOC(A,DIM=1)==[2,1,2] and MAXLOC(A,DIM=2)==[2,3], and mutate DIM to the other dimension so the shape or values fail.
pending.MAXLOC-DIM-forwards-MASK-KIND-BACK: Use a 2x3 integer array with ties along one slice, a mask excluding one candidate, KIND=KIND(0), and BACK=.true.; assert the per-slice locations reflect mask and last-tie forwarding, then mutate BACK to .false. so a tie slice fails.

requirements.title: MAXLOC tie handling follows BACK and array element order
requirements.definition: A unique maximum returns that element's subscripts; tied maxima return the first in array element order absent BACK or with BACK false, and the last with BACK true.

pending.MAXLOC-unique-maximum-location: Use [2,6,4,5] and assert MAXLOC returns [2]; mutate the unique maximum position so the expected location fails.
pending.MAXLOC-tie-first-absent-BACK: Use [2,6,4,6] and assert MAXLOC without BACK returns [2]; mutate the expected index to 4 so the first-tie check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-tie-first-BACK-false: Use [2,6,4,6] with BACK=.false. and assert result [2]; mutate BACK to .true. so the check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-tie-last-BACK-true: Use [2,6,4,6] with BACK=.true. and assert result [4]; mutate BACK to .false. so the check fails.

requirements.title: MAXLOC character arrays use intrinsic relational ordering
requirements.definition: For character ARRAY, MAXLOC uses the value selected by intrinsic relational operators and the collating sequence for the character kind.

pending.MAXLOC-default-character-letter-location: Use a default-character rank-one array ['A','B','A'] whose letter order is guaranteed by 7.4.4.4; assert MAXLOC(array) == [2]. Mutate the middle element to 'A' so the selected location check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-default-character-digit-location: Use a default-character rank-one array ['1','9','1'] whose digit order is guaranteed by 7.4.4.4; assert MAXLOC(array) == [2]. Mutate the middle element to '1' so the selected location check fails.
pending.MAXLOC-default-character-BACK-tie-locati: Use default-character ['B','A','B'] so the maximum value is tied under the 7.4.4.4-guaranteed letter order; assert MAXLOC(array) == [1], MAXLOC(array,BACK=.false.) == [1], and MAXLOC(array,BACK=.true.) == [3]. Mutate BACK=.true. to BACK=.false. so the last-tie check fails.
